title: Riftweave file
description: The file both apps trade (APP-30, docs/backend/files.md): one envelope around exactly what the command contract already returns. Both apps write it with keys sorted, a two-space indent, and a final newline. The settings file keeps its own format, which already names its kind (settings.schema.json).

rules_version.description: The rules the file was made with (core.RulesVersion). Another version warns, and the file still opens when its data validates.

modules.description: The modules enabled where the file was made, by manifest id and version. A module the importing device does not load stops the import, naming the rows at stake, until the person enables it or confirms the loss.

character.description: With a character: its sync fields (BE_S07_03, docs/backend/files.md#the-character-list). A character file without them imports as a new character.

data.description: A stored actor (character), a session (session), or a spell row as spells/core.json holds it (spell).
